easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Play Maestros Theater.
When Maestros Theater enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Maestros Theater.
Resolve the Maestros Theater trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it, search your library for an applicable land and put it onto the battlefield tapped, and gain 1 life.
Haru triggers, returning Maestros Theater from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
